description: This file defines functions related to summarizing and creating default objects for task registry data, including task status counts, runtime counts, and overall registry summaries. It also provides a function to generate a summary from a collection of task records.

methods.name: function createEmptyTaskStatusCounts(): TaskStatusCounts { createEmptyTaskStatusCounts
methods.description: Creates and returns an object with counts of various task statuses initialized to zero.

methods.name: function createEmptyTaskRuntimeCounts(): TaskRuntimeCounts { createEmptyTaskRuntimeCounts
methods.description: Creates and returns an object with counts of different task runtimes initialized to zero.

methods.name: export function createEmptyTaskRegistrySummary(): TaskRegistrySummary { createEmptyTaskRegistrySummary
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty task registry summary object, aggregating status and runtime counts.

methods.name: export function summarizeTaskRecords(records: Iterable<TaskRecord>): TaskRegistrySummary { summarizeTaskRecords
methods.description: Generates a TaskRegistrySummary by iterating over an iterable of TaskRecord objects, updating counts based on each record's status and runtime.
